description: SUMO Ingolstadt scenario InTAS provides the InTAS SUMO scenario with roads, signals, parking, bus schedules and pedestrian support. The provider is InTAS researchers. Geographical and temporal coverage: The model covers 24 hours in Ingolstadt, Germany, and is described as checked against traffic counts. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-3.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Validation is developer-reported and was not reproduced. Compatibility depends on the selected SUMO version. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
